title: POST /game-api/s2s-api/v1.0/lobby/rooms/createBan
$comment: Observed on 1.8.0.13 by issuing `#ban create <identityId> 600 <reason>` over RCON: 200, 15 bytes. The ban lands in the backend, per room, and nothing is written to the server's disk - see sections 4.4 and 5.7 of the RCON and profile documents. Then observed again from outside the game, with the server process already killed and nothing but the stored ownerToken.bin: within the few minutes the room survives without heartbeats this call still answers {"status":"OK"} and the record appears in listActiveBans; once the room is gone, every ban call for it - reading the list included - answers 404 MpRoomNotFound. See 'A ban needs a live room, not a live server' in docs/en/ArmaReforger_BackendAPI_EN.md.

userId.description: Who is banned. The field is called userId even for an identityId, and an admin can supply either a playerId (resolved server-side) or the identity directly, as the RCON client does.

reason.description: Free text from the admin. It comes back verbatim in the ban record's reason and issuer fields.

banDuration.description: Seconds. 0 is the RCON convention for permanent, and the captured record's expiresAt - createdAt equals the requested value.
